principle: Image generation defines a visual-quality ceiling and art-direction target; semantic IR remains the source of truth and a flattened full-slide picture never counts as editable-slide success.

native_editable.purpose: Measure current structured editable-slide quality without a visual oracle.
native_editable.expected_output: editable PPTX plus fixed-pipeline PNG renders

image_oracle.purpose: Measure the unconstrained visual ceiling for the same semantic inputs.
image_oracle.source: fresh full-slide image generation with exact semantic payload and no invented claims
image_oracle.expected_output: three 16:9 oracle images plus prompt/generation hashes

hybrid_editable_reconstruction.purpose: Measure how much oracle visual quality can be retained while preserving editable semantic structure.
hybrid_editable_reconstruction.source: semantic IR plus oracle image as art-direction evidence
hybrid_editable_reconstruction.expected_output: editable native text/geometry plus replaceable assets, PPTX realization trace, fixed-pipeline renders

legacy_reference.use: adversarial visual reference and harness smoke-test only
legacy_reference.reason_not_canonical_oracle: Stage 3 image-first generation exhibited semantic leakage and therefore cannot define semantic truth for reconstruction.

comparison_rule: Do not declare the system visually successful unless hybrid_editable_reconstruction materially closes the visual gap to image_oracle while retaining the engineering gates of native_editable.
freeze_policy: Do not freeze current Stage 4 aesthetics before this benchmark is reviewed.
